rationale: Pivot from xgb_rank_fusion (8-iter train sweep #667-#674 plateaued at 1-4/7 with avg_ann -3% to +25%, no monotone improvement past iter #669) to new xgb_recency_consensus. Default 1/7 (only W2 +29.5%) is below rank_fusion's default 3/7, BUT default 60d half-life is on the aggressive end of the [20, 150] HP range — W6 collapsed from rank_fusion's +29% to -65% specifically because the recent head over-weights the late-2024/early-2025 train rows whose signal inverts in W6 test. The 14-dim HP space includes two structurally novel knobs (recency_halflife_days, min_recent_weight) plus the existing strict_win/magnitude axes, giving train mode wide latitude to find a half-life that filters bear-regime overconfidence in W1/W4/W5/W7 without killing W6. Push half-life up (120-150d) and min_recent_weight up (0.3-0.4) to soften the recent head toward the full head; if no HP combo beats rank_fusion's best 3/7 after 8-10 sweep iters, next claude iter should pivot.
